data.name: Open House Real Estate Electric Bike Tour
data.headline: "Live the Dream" Bicycle throughout Honolulu's marvels of wealth and doing a walk through.
data.description:
Roll through your very own open house guided bicycle tour with a local real estate professional. As we pedal through marvels of health and wealth infused into Honolulu's fine beachfront neighborhoods. 
We drop in on select open-house properties that share the Aloha spirit of the Islands. We will walk through these homes and experience the beauty of these properties. Follow your experience with a delicious Hawaiian cuisine dinner on Sundays, 1:00 pm-5:30 pm.  This out-of-the-box experience includes professional photos, informative narration, inclusive meals, snacks, and hydration.
data.highlights: Tasting the wealth, seeing what could be, and learning about real estate from a professional guide with 44 years of Hawaii real estate experience.
data.itinerary: We meet up at the famous Waikiki Kuhio Beach Hula Mound.  There, we roll out of Waikiki onto the Gold Coast of the Diamond Head neighborhood, where we check out affluent waterfront condominiums. We then roll around the back of Diamond Head on our electric (Stallons) Bikes, visiting a selection of homes known as the marvels of wealth of the Pacific. We finish this amazing experience with a local meal that is one part of our popular Hawaiian Foodie Bike Tour.

data.cancellation_notes: We are sorry you had to cancel your tour with us. Please feel free to book again when your plans permit.  Your credit card will be refunded in the next 24 hours.  A confirmation email will be sent showing your refund.  Please reach out to us if you have any questions.
data.booking_notes:
Aloha HAWAII visitors. Your tour booking is confirmed. We are excited to share our Island with you. Be sure to meet up at the Kuhio Beach Banyan Tree (Waikiki Beach) during your tour time.  We will have drinks, snacks, and sunscreen for you. Please wear the appropriate clothing and covered shoes for bicycling.  Be sure to bring your iPhone/Android or recording device to capture those special memories to share with family and friends  Note: "Backpacks are not recommended", Bikes have a small bag to store your items.  
 Aloha and Mahalo for joining us, we look forward to meeting you.
